WITH perRaceStats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.raceId,
    r.name AS raceName,
    AVG(cr.points) AS perRaceAvg,
    COUNT(*) AS resultCount
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name
),
raceNameStats AS (
  SELECT 
    raceName,
    AVG(perRaceAvg) AS raceNameAvg
  FROM perRaceStats
  GROUP BY raceName
)
SELECT 
  prs.raceId,
  prs.raceName,
  prs.perRaceAvg,
  prs.resultCount,
  CASE 
    WHEN rns.raceNameAvg IS NULL OR rns.raceNameAvg = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE prs.perRaceAvg / rns.raceNameAvg
  END AS ratio
FROM perRaceStats prs
LEFT JOIN raceNameStats rns ON prs.raceName = rns.raceName
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN rns.raceNameAvg IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC,
  prs.raceId
LIMIT 10
